title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deep dive. US midterm Election Day is today, Tue Nov 3. Briefs and deep dives now come from April's new chat (updated Nov 3, 7:40 AM AZ).

sections.title: World
sections.body_md: US midterm Election Day is today, Tue Nov 3. No races called yet in the trackers checked this morning.

items.headline_md: **US midterms:** Election Day opens with **57M+** early votes; House and Senate control at stake
items.summary_md: Polls opened Tuesday after more than 57 million Americans already voted early (University of Florida Voting Lab). All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are on the ballot; Republicans hold a razor-thin House edge and 53–47 in the Senate.

items.headline_md: Update: **US** strikes **Iran’s Qeshm Island** as midterm voting begins
items.summary_md: US officials told CBS/BBC the limited defensive strikes responded to IRGC fire on a US aircraft. Iranian media reported explosions on Qeshm; Iran said it downed US drones. Talks via Qatar and Pakistan continued.

items.headline_md: **Ukraine:** 18 killed, 27 missing in Russian strike on **Zaporizhzhia** aid school
items.summary_md: Ukrainian authorities said Monday that 18 were killed and 27 missing in a Russian attack on Komyshuvakha. President Zelenskyy wrote that 10 aerial bombs struck a school where people were receiving humanitarian aid.

items.headline_md: **Belgium:** PM **Bart De Wever** tenders resignation over budget impasse
items.summary_md: De Wever (N-VA) offered resignation Monday after the five-party coalition deadlocked on the budget. King Philippe deferred a decision and will consult coalition leaders.

items.headline_md: **Supreme Court** rejects Trump bid to quarantine California mail ballots
items.summary_md: In a one-line unsigned order with no noted dissents, the Court denied the Justice Department’s request for an injunction requiring California officials to separate about 20,000 mail ballots from a "likely noncitizen" list.

items.headline_md: Election Day weather: floods force **Florida** polling moves; storms hit South
items.summary_md: Officials moved at least 17 polling locations in five Florida counties after intense rainfall and flash flooding. A tornado watch covered parts of Oklahoma, Texas, and Arkansas overnight.

items.headline_md: **Apple** beats on Q4 sales; **margin guide** sinks stock in Ternus’s first report
items.summary_md: Fiscal Q4 revenue was $114.5B (+12% YoY) and diluted EPS $2.10 (+14%), beating estimates. December-quarter gross-margin guide of 45–46% (on memory costs) sent shares down about 3% after hours / ~3.8% premarket.

items.headline_md: **Aramco** Q3 profit up **34%** to $36.25B amid war-driven refining margins
items.summary_md: Net income rose to $36.25B from about $26.9B a year earlier despite Hormuz and infrastructure attacks; CNBC cited adjusted net income of $31.2B (+9%) and downstream adjusted earnings of $10.3B (+234%).

items.headline_md: **Nvidia** tells cloud partners: cap China at under **half** of new deals — FT
items.summary_md: Citing five people, the FT said Nvidia verbally instructed data-center partners that new cloud contracts must sell at least 51% of services outside China; the guidance was not described as a written policy.

items.headline_md: **Palantir** beats, but stock drops on slower **US commercial** bookings
items.summary_md: Revenue nearly doubled and topped $2B for the first time, with US commercial revenue surpassing US government, but shares slumped roughly 7–8% premarket as US commercial booking growth slowed.

items.headline_md: **RBA** hikes to **4.85%**; Asia tech shares slide before US midterms
items.summary_md: Australia’s Reserve Bank raised its cash rate 25 bp to 4.85% in a 6–3 vote. MSCI Asia ex-Japan fell 1.4%, with South Korea down as much as 4.1% and Taiwan 3.6%.

items.headline_md: **Top Hat** Fall Showcase: **Spooky Tales** publish deal; **Ova Magica** consoles Nov 10
items.summary_md: Top Hat will publish Liminal Road’s retro horror anthology Spooky Tales on Steam PC, and Ova Magica hits Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation and Xbox on Nov 10, with more 2027 indie titles lined up.

items.headline_md: **John Romero** confirms Xbox-canceled **Romero Games** shooter has a new (unnamed) publisher
items.summary_md: After Xbox canceled the AAA shooter and the studio shrank, then rebuilt to about 15 people, Romero told VGC they closed a deal with someone he knew but can’t name yet; the game is a full redesign reusing prior art and code.

items.headline_md: Nov 3 iOS soft launches: **Timber Jam: Tree Sort**, **Popli: Drop & Merge**, **PortalPang Defense**
items.summary_md: Scaling Radar’s Nov 3 games list flags fresh iOS drops including MOBIRIX’s PortalPang Defense, Timber Jam: Tree Sort, and Popli: Drop & Merge—new-release tracking, not chart claims.

items.headline_md: SNAPP Attack Nov 2–8 iOS roundup: **Aeterna Loop**, **ASTRA TACTICS**, **Parryfall**, more
items.summary_md: SNAPP’s week roundup frames a big post-Halloween App Store push including Aeterna Loop, ASTRA TACTICS, RAYNE: Covert Ops, Parryfall, War Pigeon, and many more before the App Store freeze.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md:
**Wii U lifter watch:** the early-Oct r/decomps PowerPC→x86 lifter (Mario 3D World / MK8 / NSMBU / Splatoon / BOTW claim) still has no newly public “when stable” GitHub drop. Separate experiments (nWiiURecomp, CafeRecomp, DolRecomp paths) are not that release. Reddit r/decomps and r/emulation RSS timed out this run; items below are from GitHub/aggregators and news sites.

**Watch notes:** KytyPS5 only had a routine save-mount fix (not a milestone). No verified 48h milestones for Kirikae, AnyPS5 Astro Bot, or a Resident Evil 4 GameCube→PC recomp. LASRecomp is still not stable (Arc test build only).

items.headline_md: First public **Switch 2** emulator build (**Eden-NX2**) plays **Mario Kart World** and **Donkey Kong Bananza** (rough)
items.summary_md: Takoroka’s pre-release Eden fork runs commercial Switch 2 games on Windows PC—playable-ish, not polished. Coverage cites mesh/shader errors, Mario Kart World stuttering, and DK Bananza struggling to hit 60 fps on strong hardware (own dumps required).

items.headline_md: Jailbroken **PS5** homebrew: **Hydroid** runs Android games; **EglantinePS5** brings experimental **Switch 2** emu
items.summary_md: Hydroid runs native 64-bit Android titles on jailbroken PS5 (FW ≤13.60); EglantinePS5 is an early Eden/Eglantine port with experimental Switch 2 support, DualSense features, and mixed early game reports.

items.headline_md: **MediEvil** (PS1) static recomp reaches version **1.0** (AI-free)
items.summary_md: flaffymg and DerpPrincess’s RecompOne-based MediEvil recomp hits 1.0 with stability, audio/FMV, shader, and mod-hub upgrades for Windows/macOS/Linux (own disc). AllRecomps also lists MediEvilRecomp v1.0.3 dated Nov 2.

items.headline_md: Update: **Wind Waker HD** PC recomp drops devel-build d2c6f97 (pause-menu, GameCube prompts, Android half-speed fix)
items.summary_md: ZeldaWWHDRecomp posted a Nov 2 development build (not a formal release) with QoL and platform fixes on top of v0.5.0; latest stable remains v0.5.0 (Oct 29). Needs your own Wii U dump.

items.headline_md: **LASRecomp** ships test-462-arc-4 diagnostics for Intel Arc “device lost” leaving Mysterious Woods
items.summary_md: The Arc-focused pre-release adds lighting diagnostics for issue #462; general users should stay on latest beta. Still not stable without crashes. AllRecomps still lists general beta_5.4 (Oct 29).

items.headline_md: AllRecomps flood Nov 2–3: **Midtown Madness 3**, Xbox 360 **F.E.A.R.**, **God of War** (2005) PS2, **Kirby Air Ride**, more
items.summary_md: Notable PC-oriented detections include Midtown Madness 3 v2.3.2, F.E.A.R. Xbox 360 Recompiled v1.6.0, God of War (2005) launcher-v0.2.8, and Kirby Air Ride v1.3.1. One-line Switch-hardware: SwitchWakerHD v1.1.0; Black Ops II Requiem NX 0.3.1.
items.details_md:
**What AllRecomps is**
- An independent, free catalog of static recompilations, source ports, reimplementations and game-specific compatibility layers for older games. It hosts no ROMs, ISOs, BIOS files or executables; it only links to each project's own repo ([About](https://allrecomps.com/about/), [Terms](https://allrecomps.com/terms/)).
- **Who runs it:** the homepage's "Behind AllRecomps" box credits the creator as **Bumyzada** ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bumyzada), [@bumyye](https://www.instagram.com/bumyye/)). Contact is allrecompsadmin@allrecomps.com ([Contact](https://allrecomps.com/contact/)). No real name is given.
- **How long it's been around:** it's very new. The domain was registered on **Oct 12, 2026** ([RDAP](https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/allrecomps.com)), and the first Wayback snapshot is from that same day ([archive](https://web.archive.org/web/2026*/allrecomps.com)). The catalog "began with an export from a Discord bot catalog," then added details from READMEs and release pages ([About](https://allrecomps.com/about/)).
- **How it works:** each project gets a page showing the original console, the target system, its stage, and sourced notes with "checked" dates. The site also has console, Switch, Android, browser and VR hubs, a [decomp-progress](https://allrecomps.com/decomp-progress/) tracker, and an [Updates](https://allrecomps.com/updates/) feed that auto-detects new GitHub releases (pre-releases excluded).
- **Affiliation:** none. It doesn't represent the listed maintainers or any game company, and listing a project isn't an endorsement ([Editorial](https://allrecomps.com/editorial/)). The site runs labeled Clickadu ads.

**Recomp vs. decomp vs. emulation**
- **Static recomp:** a tool translates the game's machine code into C/C++ ahead of time. That code is then compiled into a real PC program, with a runtime standing in for the console hardware ([guide](https://allrecomps.com/guides/what-is-a-recompilation/)).
- **Decomp:** people rebuild readable source code that compiles back to the original game, and source ports are built on top of it.
- **Emulation:** a program pretends to be the console while it runs. A *compatibility layer* (like the PS4 ports here) runs the original x86 code directly and swaps out the system services ([guide](https://allrecomps.com/guides/ports-recompilations-and-emulation/)).

**The Nov 2–3 flood** (75 releases detected: 22 on Nov 3 and 53 on Nov 2, per [Updates](https://allrecomps.com/updates/))
- **Midtown Madness 3** (Xbox → Windows 10/11). It's now at **v2.5**, past the v2.3.2 in this morning's summary, and ships an MM3-Setup.exe installer. You need your own ISO ([repo](https://github.com/lakshya16157/midtown-madness-3-PC-Native/releases), [page](https://allrecomps.com/games/midtown-madness-3-7710b994f8/)). A separate project, mm3-recomp, also exists.
- **F.E.A.R. + F.E.A.R. Files** (Xbox 360 → PC via ReXGlue). v1.6.0 has Windows and Linux zips ([repo](https://github.com/Juansolo457/fear360-recomp/releases)). AllRecomps' blurb still calls it "source-only," based on its Oct 25 check, so that part is out of date ([page](https://allrecomps.com/games/manual-fear360-recomp-98fba97/)).
- **God of War (2005)** (PS2 USA → Windows, with experimental Linux). Statically recompiled to C++ with OpenGL 4.6, about 30 GB free space needed. Launcher v0.2.9 came out Nov 3 ([repo](https://github.com/danielalves96/gow-pc-port/releases), [page](https://allrecomps.com/games/god-of-war-ps2-danielalves96/)).
- **Kirby Air Ride** (GameCube USA → Windows x64). v1.3.1 needs your own GKYE01 disc ([repo](https://github.com/sonsegajp/Kirby-Air-Ride-Recompiled/releases), [page](https://allrecomps.com/games/discovery-sonsegajp-kirby-air-ride-recompiled/)).
- **Other native-PC picks:** [PGR2 v1.6.0](https://github.com/hk21x/pgr2-recomp/releases), [ICO port v0.10.0](https://github.com/nathanialf/ico-pc/releases), [Def Jam Vendetta v0.4.5](https://github.com/jcsix694/def-jam-vendetta-recomp/releases) and [WWE '12 v1.0.0](https://github.com/iMrBurn/wwe12-pc/releases), the last still labeled beta.
- **Not native recomps:** NHL 24, Driveclub, Uncharted and Bloodborne (bbhost) are PS4 compatibility layers. Civilization Revolution and King Kong are listed as "Target unconfirmed."

**Why it matters / caveats**
- This is the easiest way to watch a fast-moving scene where many projects ship native PC builds.
- I found no listing that looked fake, but I didn't audit any of them. The site itself says its checks "are not code audits or execution tests" ([Editorial](https://allrecomps.com/editorial/)), so playability is the authors' own claim everywhere. Every PC pick above was confirmed only by its GitHub release files.
- The repos are young: GoW was created Oct 30, Kirby Oct 25 and F.E.A.R. Oct 22 ([GitHub API](https://api.github.com/repos/danielalves96/gow-pc-port)). Download only from each repo's Releases page, not from ad links.
- You always need your own legally owned game files.

items.headline_md: Update: Halloween weekend finals — **You Can See Everything** $11.45M narrowly tops **Clayface** $11.00M; **Wildwood** $8.95M
items.summary_md: Domestic Weekend 44 (Oct 30–Nov 1): You Can See Everything $11,445,629; Clayface $11,002,116; Wildwood $8,949,324. The Numbers total reporting movies ~$62.0M. Earlier Rentrak estimates were preliminary.

items.headline_md: Halloween weekend ticket sales down ~42% WoW; 2026 YTD still ~+20% vs 2025
items.summary_md: citybiz (Rentrak/Seeking Alpha, preliminary) frames ~$55.7M weekend (−42.1% WoW) but ahead of 2025’s comparable weekend; domestic YTD ~$8.46B (+20.1%).

items.headline_md: **Wildwood** 99%/97% RT; **You Can See Everything** 96%/96%; **Clayface** 77%/94%
items.summary_md: Rotten Tomatoes: LAIKA’s Wildwood 99% Tomatometer (164) / 97% Popcornmeter; A24’s You Can See Everything 96%/96%; DCU Clayface 77%/94%.

items.headline_md: Nov 6 wide: **The Cat in the Hat**, **Godzilla Minus Zero** (93% RT), **Wild Horse Nine** (93% RT), **Jimmy**, **Drummer Boy**
items.summary_md: Friday’s slate includes Bill Hader’s Cat in the Hat; Takashi Yamazaki’s Godzilla Minus Zero (93% early Tomatometer, 56 reviews); and Martin McDonagh’s Wild Horse Nine (93%/120).

items.headline_md: **The Only Living Pickpocket in New York** explodes +1,255% to $1.88M on wide expansion
items.summary_md: Sony’s film jumped to $1,878,274 (+1,254.6%) on 1,112 theaters (was ~6), cume $2,082,194 in week 3—a standout expansion play in a soft frame.

items.headline_md: Hits VOD/digital today: **Resident Evil**, **Primetime**, **Sense and Sensibility**, **Bad Apples**
items.summary_md: Nov 3 digital includes Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil, Robert Pattinson’s Primetime, Daisy Edgar-Jones’s Sense and Sensibility, and Saoirse Ronan’s Bad Apples.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** discloses **$895.4B** compute commitments, ~**$17B** Q3 revenue ahead of IPO
items.summary_md: Amended SEC filing shows AI infrastructure commitments of $895.4B as of Sept 30, with Q3 revenue $16.962B (+46.7% QoQ) and an operating loss of $567M after a profitable Q2.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** launches **Grid Protectors** program so AI campuses can cut power when grids strain
items.summary_md: Working with utilities and regulators, OpenAI cites a Georgia Power model that can provide up to 1,000 MW of flexible demand response (~700,000 households of average demand).

items.headline_md: **Anthropic**, **OpenAI**, **Google**, **Microsoft** to support common robots.txt AI-scrape opt-out
items.summary_md: Major AI labs backed a shared robots.txt signal so publishers can express one preference to multiple crawlers; Anthropic already supporting, OpenAI in coming months, Google and Microsoft next year.

items.headline_md: **Flower Labs** releases **Endeavor 1.1**; **Meituan** ships **LongCat-2.5** multimodal MoE
items.summary_md: Endeavor 1.1 claims stronger reasoning/coding vs 1.0 plus multimodal inputs and EU/on-prem options. Meituan’s LongCat-2.5 is a 1.6T-parameter MoE (~48B active) for agentic multimodal coding.

items.headline_md: **Apple** advertising hits an all-time revenue record; Services **$31.573B** (+10%)
items.summary_md: Fiscal Q4 Services were $31.573B (+9.8% YoY); CFO Parekh said advertising set an all-time record (no dollar breakout). Maps ads are live in the US and Canada.

items.headline_md: **Apple App Store:** dating & AI romantic companions get minimum **18+** (declarations start Nov 16)
items.summary_md: From Nov 16, App Store Connect adds Dating and Relationships descriptors that force 18+ for real-person dating and romantic/sexual virtual companions; all apps must complete declarations by Jan 12, 2027.

items.headline_md: **Google Play** policy update: tighter permissions, Families Self-Certified Ads SDKs reopen, Japan payment deadline Dec 1
items.summary_md: Oct 29 packet restricts Local Network and Manage Contacts permissions, reopens Families Self-Certified Ads SDKs to new applicants, and adds Nov trader-status and Dec 1 Japan payment deadlines.

items.headline_md: **Marvell** to buy **Lumentum** in all-stock AI optics deal; **Oracle** files ~$20B raise for AI data centers
items.summary_md: Each Lumentum share converts to 4.5 Marvell shares (expected close 1H 2028); CNBC-implied EV was cited around $115B. Separately, Oracle is selling $10B common stock plus $10B senior notes for AI infrastructure.

items.summary_md: Spot gold fell 1.1% to $3,904.69/oz; US Dec gold futures fell 1.4% to $3,914.70 as higher oil fed inflation and rate fears.

items.summary_md: BTC edged about +0.2% to ~$76,900 after a ~$76,300 low. Spot bitcoin ETFs saw $399M outflows Monday (Farside), with BlackRock IBIT −$405M.

items.summary_md: Around 1:51 AM AZ: 10-year yield about 4.917%, 30-year ~5.288%, 2-year ~4.596%. JOLTS due later this week; payrolls Friday.
